title: 第1968章 神女恩公拒绝离开第1967章 养蛋心路界河风云
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
下一秒。
蛋的周围闪耀出炽热的光芒，将所有人笼罩在里面。
陈青玄隐约透过这光芒看见了一道倩影。
紧接着，就有清脆的女声响起。
“你等冲撞了本神女的恩人，该当何罪！”
这声音听上去青涩，可是又透着一股不容置疑的意味。
尤其对拥有朱雀血脉的生灵而言，他们天然就要受到压制。
此刻，包括朱雀族长“朱皇地”在内的一众朱雀族，他们皆是一副等待发落的模样。
相比之下。
陈青玄就成了全场唯一不受影响的那个。
但他的内心同样不平静。
他想知道，这颗蛋究竟还瞒着自己多少事情。
它不止产生了自己的意识，看这架势甚至还拥有了一定的记忆传承。
不过，考虑到它是在替自己出头。
陈青玄干脆也就不说话了。
倒是朱皇地率先表态：“神女的恩公就是我朱雀族的恩公，我等愿意全力补偿。”
这时，陈青玄的耳边传来了声音。
正是先前的神女。
只不过，神女再没有了那副强硬的语气，反倒是带着几分邀功的兴奋劲。
“恩公，你可以提条件了，不用跟他们客气！”

陈青玄确定了这就是自己养大的那颗蛋。
它的事情稍后再算。
眼下，陈青玄是要帮助“朱雀圣灵”完成蜕变。
他于是提出了要求。
朱皇地二话不说，直接就将“朱雀圣灵”请进来朱雀族的传承之地。
陈青玄眼见目的达到了，便没再狮子大开口。
虽说他对凤凰岛是挺感兴趣的，但是得自火神的“天火息壤”就已经够他接下来参悟的了，自己没必要贪多求全。
朱皇地本来都做好了割肉的准备，没想到陈青玄这么好说话。
这倒是让他有点不好意思，生出了弥补的想法。
这暂且搁置。
现在更重要的是让神女息怒。
不多时，原本笼罩着他们的光芒消散。
那颗蛋重新回到了陈青玄的衣兜里。
陈青玄当下没有犹豫，他离开了凤凰岛一定的距离，然后停了下来。
content_en:
The next second.
A fiery light shone around the egg, enveloping everyone inside.
Chen Qingxuan vaguely saw a beautiful figure through this light.
Immediately afterwards, a clear female voice sounded.
"What kind of crime do you deserve for attacking my benefactor?"
The voice sounded green, but it also contained an undoubted meaning.
Especially for the creatures with Suzaku bloodline, they will naturally be suppressed.
At this moment, all the Suzaku clan members, including the Suzaku clan leader "Zhu Huangdi", looked like they were waiting to be defeated.
In contrast.
Chen Qingxuan became the only one in the audience who was not affected.
But he was also not at peace inside.
He wanted to know how many things the egg was hiding from him.
Not only did it generate its own consciousness, but looking at this posture, it even had a certain amount of memory inheritance.
However, consider that it is standing up for itself.
Chen Qingxuan simply stopped talking.
It was Zhu Huangdi who was the first to express his position: "The benefactor of the goddess is the benefactor of my Suzaku clan, and we are willing to fully compensate for it."
At this time, a voice came from Chen Qingxuan's ear.
It is the goddess from before.
However, the goddess no longer had that tough tone, but instead had a bit of excitement about claiming credit.
"My benefactor, you can make conditions now, there's no need to be polite to them!"
Chen Qingxuan was sure that this was the egg he had raised.
It will be settled later.
At the moment, Chen Qingxuan wants to help the "Suzaku Holy Spirit" complete its transformation.
So he made a request.
Without saying a word, Zhu Huangdi directly invited the "Suzaku Holy Spirit" into the inheritance place of the Suzaku clan.
Seeing that his goal was achieved, Chen Qingxuan stopped talking.
Although he is quite interested in Phoenix Island, the "Sky Fire Breathing Earth" obtained from the God of Fire is enough for him to comprehend next, so there is no need for him to be greedy for more.
Zhu Huangdi was already prepared to cut his flesh, but he didn't expect Chen Qingxuan to be so easy to talk to.
This actually made him a little embarrassed, and he had the idea of ​​​​making up for it.
Let’s put that aside for now.
What is more important now is to calm the goddess down.
After a while, the light that originally shrouded them dissipated.
The egg returned to Chen Qingxuan's pocket.
Chen Qingxuan did not hesitate at the moment. He left Phoenix Island for a certain distance and then stopped.
